items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: This zero-day unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to inject malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) for this critical flaw with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe advises applying this update in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover and other vulnerabilities
items.summary: This update resolves seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could also lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability via Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: A critical remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce is caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files. Adobe released patches addressing this flaw as part of the APSB26-73 security bulletin.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension (CVE-2026-45247) allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) to address this critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.8.
